defs.def: to give food to a person or an animal 给（人或动物）食物；喂养；饲养

ex.s: “Feeding is a long game,” says Markey.
ex.t: “喂养是一场持久战，”Markey说。

ex.s: She is critical of the way she was fed.
ex.t: 她对自己被喂养的方式持批评态度。

ex.s: They acted awkwardly while feeding the dog.
ex.t: 他们在喂狗时表现得很笨拙。

ex.s: She’s fed up with it.
ex.t: 她已经受够了。

ex.s: A taste for meat is   63   (actual) behind the change: An important part of its corn is used to feed chickens, pigs, and cattle.
ex.t: 对肉的喜好是这一变化背后的___63___（actual）原因：其玉米的重要部分被用来喂养鸡、猪和牛。

ex.s: Many fish perform suction feeding that requires specialised body parts to quickly generate air pressure that can draw nearby food into their mouths.
ex.t: 许多鱼类进行吸食式进食，这需要特殊的身体部位快速产生气压，将附近的食物吸入嘴里。

ex.s: Meowing starts as soon as a baby cat is brought to life and uses it to get the mother's attention and be fed.
ex.t: 喵喵叫从小猫一出生就开始，它用这种方式引起猫妈妈的注意并得到喂养。

ex.s: To feed the animals.
ex.t: 为了喂养动物。

ex.s: When I post the picture online, I will make a comment about how bad it is to feed wild crocodiles.
ex.t: 当我在网上发布图片时，我会评论喂养野生鳄鱼有多糟糕。

ex.s: Thinking on his feet, Lin started to tell a story about a cruel Roman emperor who tried to feed a man to wild animals.
ex.t: 林语堂灵机一动，开始讲一个故事，关于一位残忍的罗马皇帝试图把一个人喂给野兽。

ex.s: People have been working together to record its migration and make sure that there are enough plants for it to feed on.
ex.t: 人们一直在共同努力记录它的迁徙，并确保有足够的植物供它觅食。

defs.def: to eat food 婴儿或动物
to provide food for a family or group of people 养，养活（全家、一群人）

ex.s: China’s approach to protecting its environment while   70   (feed) its citizens “offers useful lessons for agriculture and food policymakers worldwide,” says the bank’s Juergen Voegele.
ex.t: 中国在保护环境的同时70（养活）公民的做法"为全球农业和食品政策制定者提供了有益的启示，"银行的Juergen Voegele说。

ex.s: “One strip of darker shells might get you about two cans of smaller tuna, but the red ones are worth more, For the red ones, one strip might get enough tuna to feed a big family for a long time.
ex.t: 一条颜色较深的贝壳条大约能换到两罐较小的金枪鱼，但红色的更值钱；至于红色的，一条可能换来足够养活一大家人很久的金枪鱼。

defs.def: to give a plant a special substance to make it grow 施（肥等）
to give advice, information, etc. to sb/sth 提供（意见或信息等）；灌输
to supply sth to sb/sth 供给；供应
to put or push sth into or through a machine 把 … 放进机器；将 … 塞进机器

ex.s: If you have a juicer, you can simply feed in frozen bananas and some berries or sliced fruit.
ex.t: 如果你有一个果汁机，你可以简单地在冰冻的香蕉和一些浆果或切片的水果中觅食。

ex.s: This makes a fun activity for a children’s party; they love feeding the fruit and frozen bananas into the top of the machine and watching the ice cream come out below.
ex.t: 这对儿童派对来说是个有趣的活动；他们喜欢把水果和冷冻香蕉从机器顶端投入，看着冰淇淋从下方出来。

ex.s: The boats drive them away from the places where they feed and interrupt their routine of resting and taking care of their young.
ex.t: 船只把它们从觅食的地方赶走，打扰了它们休息和照顾幼崽的日常。

defs.def: to satisfy a need, desire, etc. and keep it strong 满足（需要、愿望、欲望等）
to become stronger because of sth else 因 … 而壮大；从 … 中得到滋养

ex.s: Our exhibits will feed your mind but what about your body?
ex.t: 我们的展品会喂饱你的头脑，但你的身体呢？

defs.def: a meal of milk for a young baby; a meal for an animal （婴儿的）一次喂奶，一餐；（动物的）一次喂给的饲料

ex.s: This includes keeping the original environment from being touched, as well as adopting new, sustainable ways of feeding farm animals.
ex.t: 这包括防止原始环境受到影响，以及采用新的可持续喂养农场动物的方法。

defs.def: food for animals or plants 动物的饲料；植物的肥料

ex.s: Throughout their no-cost stays in   45   homes, they feed pets and water plants in the homeowner's   46  .
ex.t: 在他们免费住在   45  家期间，他们在房主   46  照料宠物、浇灌植物。

defs.def: material supplied to a machine （机器的）进料
a pipe, device, etc. which supplies a machine with sth （机器的）进料装置，进料器
a large meal 丰盛的一餐

ex.s: But compensating on the weekends actually feeds into your sleepiness the following week, a recent study found.
ex.t: 但最近的一项研究发现，在周末补觉实际上会让你下一周更困。

defs.def: television programmes that are sent from a central station to other stations in a network; the system of sending out these programmes （电视中心台）网络供给节目（系统）

ex.s: When the eggs were hatched, the baby birds made the similar chirp to their mothers—a sound that served as their regular ＂feed me!＂ call.
ex.t: 蛋孵化后，幼鸟会发出与母亲相似的声音——一种作为它们常规“喂我！”叫声的声音。
